collection_pass_contract: All 12 exact B2 modules import under a separately approved offline test-only fixture; zero import-error placeholders.
Reconcile actual collected IDs against the pre-patch static test-definition inventory (183 definitions); no removal, skip, xfail or narrowed discovery.
Report collection results for each module separately; a collected method is never counted as passed without execution.
No real formal r11 pointer/freeze, authorization, attempt, Registry claim, namespace or transaction is created.
test_pass_contract: Execute the collected methods only after a static write-path and network/inference audit of each target module.
Report per-module actual passed, failed, runtime errors, skipped and import errors; do not extrapolate from the earlier 124/124 scoped suite.
Synthetic data are confined to temporary roots; production identity and Consumer code remains unchanged and exercised for applicable boundary tests.
Existing negative lifecycle, authorization, namespace, transaction, preflight, provenance and case-start tests retain their rejection assertions.
required_negative_controls: Missing formal r11 pointer rejects the real resolver and formal consumer before authorization consumption, transaction creation or adapter.run.
Wrong r11 revision, freeze path, pointer SHA/member SHA and r10 authorization/artifact replay are rejected.
A synthetic test identity cannot be mistaken for the formal repository pointer; no shared sys.modules/mock state remains after test process exit.
Historical trace/authorization/ledger roots cannot be written; failure paths leave byte hashes and directory inventories unchanged.
No network, HTTP inference, model, Agent, RAG or formal V4 case call occurs.
protected_evidence_pre_post_checks: SHA-256, size and path inventory for both historical trace directories, including the two named traces
r10 freeze manifest and all 20 member bytes
historical authorization manifest and real append-only lifecycle ledger
failure_stop_conditions: Any required production/frozen adapter, resolver, issuer or consumer edit
Any fake formal r11 pointer/freeze or real authorization/attempt state
Any dropped test definition or collection-pass claim based on only a subset of 12 modules
Any protected evidence byte or path change
Any missing/invalid identity accepted by formal validation
